info.title: Trykatch application and module toolkit
info.description: Validates and composes Trykatch full-stack modules.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Create an application:
trykatch template install

options.name: --ui
options.description: Include the React frontend or generate a backend-only application.

options.name: --email
options.description: Include SMTP email and local Mailpit support.

options.name: --storage
options.description: Include local and S3-compatible object storage.

options.name: --images
options.description:
Include image validation and processing.
Module lifecycle:
trykatch module help     Show every module command and option.
trykatch module list     List installed modules and their state.
trykatch module doctor   Validate the full-stack module graph.
